title: Flox Intelligence is building AI to keep wildlife away from trains, airports, and roads
script:
Animals cause thousands of train delays every single year across global transport networks.
Flox Intelligence built edge devices using computer vision to identify approaching species in real time.
Once the hardware spots an animal, it plays species-specific deterrent sounds to drive them away.
CEO Sara Nozkova leads the Stockholm startup deploying these autonomous units near critical infrastructure like airports.
The autonomous units run locally on the edge without needing constant cloud connectivity to function.
These smart speakers protect high-speed trains and prevent dangerous collisions across rural rail lines.
Would you trust audio deterrents to protect wildlife near high-speed trains?
